title: People Ops growth launchpad - manager prep (Ivy Chen)
content:
Purpose: quick notes + concise evidence for upcoming 1:1 and calibration. Use this as a one-page crib to frame asks and next-quarter focus.

Topline narrative (30s): 
- Transitioned from project-delivery (onboarding & pulsing exec comms) to building repeatable growth experiments for manager enablement.
- Goal: validate 3 lightweight manager coaching patterns that scale to org of 300+ without hiring an extra IC.

Success signals I own (quantified):
- Reduce new manager time-to-first-1:1 framework adoption from 6 weeks -> 3 weeks (baseline: cohort Oct-Nov: average 5.9 weeks).
- Increase completion rate of onboarding checklist to 93% (current: 78%).
- Run 4 experiments in Q1 and surface top-2 repeatable patterns for D&I cohorts.

Concise evidence (ready-to-quote):
- Onboarding checklist gap analysis: 24 unique missing steps flagged in Oct cohort; top three missing items (payroll access, buddy intro, team norms) account for 62% of escalations.
- Pilot manager coaching: 6 managers ran micro-retros after 2 weeks; retention of action items at week 6 = 71% vs control 44%.
- Pulse NPS (new hires, week 3): improved from 6.1 -> 7.4 after targeted buddy pairing.

Manager asks (priority order):
1) Strategic: greenlight 1.5 days/mo of my time next quarter dedicated to running manager cohorts (time budget in Q1 OKR).
2) Tactical: introduce me to Director-level stakeholders at Platform Eng and Console teams for a 30-min sync (two intros).
3) Resource: approve $4k for external facilitator credits to run two intensive 2-hour manager practicum sessions.

Development asks (for my growth):
- Coaching: monthly 30-min sparring with you focused on stakeholder influence and narrative design.
- Exposure: shadow two stakeholder partnership sales calls (ops <> eng) to build comfort with cross-functional negotiation.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: program feels like add-on for busy managers -> Mitigation: time-boxed 20-min manager checklist + asynchronous micro-lessons (Slack-first delivery).
- Risk: insufficient volunteer managers for pilots -> Mitigation: partner with Solutions Eng to recruit via Customer Success-facing teams.

Concrete next 30 days (what I will deliver):
- Run sprint 0: one 60-min launch session, distribute micro-lessons (2 modules), recruit 12 managers (goal).
- Deliver a simple dashboard (sheet) tracking adoption and 3 KPIs above.
- Draft a stakeholder one-pager for Director-level review.

Snippets to say in 1:1 (soundbites):
- "I want to move from bespoke support to repeatable manager habits that reduce operational escalations by half."
- "Two experiments will show if we can scale coaching with less headcount."

Open questions I want your input on:
- Acceptable threshold for pilot success (is 60% adoption at week 6 enough to scale?).
- Prioritization: should we prioritize manager time-savings or hire-manager confidence metrics?

Quick calendar plan:
- Week 1: recruit cohort + sync with Marcus (ops metrics).
- Week 2: launch session + micro-lesson 1.
- Week 4: collect first-week pulse; adjust lesson cadence.

Notes to self (raw):
- Try 10-min voice memo instead of Slack deep-dive for better engagement.
- Keep ask small: aim for 2 clear asks in each director email.

Reference artifacts (short):
- onboarding-gap-analysis-v2 (sheet) — ticket: HR-412
- manager-practicum-outline (deck) — draft in Confluence

Micro-actions before 1:1 (today):
- Pull cohort adoption numbers and one concrete example of blocked manager.
- Draft 3-line intro for Director outreach (copy to share for intros).

Status: draft — want to iterate after brief with Marcus.

---
Meta: save as single-page to use as speaking notes; keep this doc private in users/ until I ask to move to shared_drives/people-ops.
